title: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
instructions: Take a medium sized chicken, singe and draw and prepare it, put in casserole whole, add a good lump of butter,  onion,  salt and pepper. Steam gently on top of range two hours, then add mushrooms and vegetables to taste; brown and serve hot. --LIZZIE TOMNEY.
